title: That Single Step Toward an Unseen Future

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo! Tell me this isn't true!
The shop is
gone?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot a distraught Pearl standing in
front
of a bento shop.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... Pinch me. I must be
dreaming—how could this bento
shop
close?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your flavors have been passed down and
enjoyed by generations! Losing a bento
shop is the same as losing part of Japan,
so please
don't say you're quitting!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
Pearl... I'd like to keep going if I
could, but business has
been slow.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
All we get are regulars, which means most
of the bentos go to waste
every day. It's
been tough... so I had to make this
decision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shop owner droops his shoulders in
disappointment. His
frustration is as clear
as day.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...It's too early for you to give up.
The fact that you only get a few
customers means
that there's plenty of people who haven't
tasted your food yet, am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We need to spread the word! The world
needs to know about these
brilliant
bentos!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Leave it all to me!
I promise I'll save your
shop!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let me introduce you to someone. He's an
acquaintance of my father and a sales
advisor. When I told him about your bento
shop, he
agreed to help.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First things first,
we'll need to draft up a
long-term business plan. I
know, we'll aim
to open stores across the nation!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: I-is that really possible?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you want to increase sales, then
everyone knows you have to
expand your
target market! Simple is best!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And once word starts spreading about
your bentos, you'll become a national
brand! Even international expansion might
not be just a pipe
dream!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, the world is hungry for your bentos!
Let's move to the next
phase of the plan!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hrm... It's usually a ghost town around
these parts, so I doubt I'll be eyeing

international expansion anytime soon...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Pearl! What's wrong, something got
you down? Could it be...
you're so hungry
you can't move a muscle?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! How did you know?! How am I
supposed to go work out like
this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! Well then, this is your lucky
day! I've got a deluxe bento
with balanced
nutrients that'll power up your next
workout!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pearl has decided to film a commercial for
the bento shop. According
to her, this
kind of program is all the rage overseas.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now we just need to do some editing and
slap some multilingual
subtitles on it. Then
we upload it for the world to see! Don't 
underestimate the power of social media!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
You want to upload it? ...Uh,
you think it'll be okay? I've heard social
media can be
scary... and I really don't want any
backlash...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All we're doing is advertising your
bentos—no one could hate on you for that!
More importantly, think about all the
orders that will soon
come in! ♪

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I can't even sell all my bentos each day
as-is... Doubt I'll get any fans from a
quick
video...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bento shop owner looks even more
dispirited than earlier. It must
be hard for
him to follow Pearl's gung ho approach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them probably have different
visions for the future of the
shop. But deep
down, I'm sure the owner also wants to see
his shop make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During one of Pearl's recording breaks, I
ask her again about what
bentos mean to
her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... love? No,
that's not
quite it. The best way to
describe these
bentos... is that they taste like home.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just one bite is enough to fully immerse
my taste buds. I see places
I've never been
to—ancient Japanese landscapes. Haha,
it's a one-of-a-kind experience.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The owner's kindness is reflected through
the bentos he makes. The taste of home is
sweet enough to wash away all the stress
of everyday
life.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Please, try one for yourself. I recommend
the chikuzenni! The bamboo shoots are
firm and chewy, but they're packed with
flavor—a true
work of art!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
His bentos are like jewelry boxes filled
with masterpiece after masterpiece! His
works have the power to move the world...
I'm sure
of it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pearl's answer to my question is more
passionate than I had expected. I can see
her love for bentos through her dedication
to helping the
owner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Pearl is this confident,
then I'm sure the bentos are world-class
quality. However,
the owner himself still looks down in the
dumps...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We need to give him the courage to take
another step—the first step
towards a
brighter future.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. What's over here? I'm quite
busy with my "Worldwide
Bento Project,"
you know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? A food truck? For the students at
Tracen? ...Wait, isn't that the
shop's
name?!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Pearl and her trainer!
You can see
for yourself, but the shop's
booming!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I never would have thought of opening a
food truck! This is near
Tracen Academy,
so plenty of students pass by every day!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hrm...
I was so busy feeling sorry for myself
I lost sight of what was most important.
You know, the customers buying my
bentos.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Owner... I didn't know you were that
heartbroken...

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
But now, I can look my customers proudly
in the eye again. It's like
you said Pearl,
expansion isn't just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...!
Haha, I'm glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well then, back to business! International
expansion, here I come!
...Kidding,
kidding!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful dream. I wish you the
best of luck! And I'll do my
best to help,
too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You hear that, everyone? It's first come,
first served! Are you really
going to pass
up a soon-to-be internationally-acclaimed
bento?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
One bite and you're hooked! Mmmmm!
Amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Pearl's marketing,
all the bentos
sell out for the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting hungry as well! ...Oh no,
I was
so wrapped up in selling
bentos that I
forgot to leave some for us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You know me too well, Trainer! Come on,
let's go sit on that bench
and eat! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sit down next to Pearl and take a
bite of
the bento. In an instant, my
heart is filled
with relaxing memories of home...
